column5: FIXED this pass, MONEY: the fiat line under the amount field ran `safeAmountUsd(amount, priceUsd ?? 0)`, which flattens unknown to 0, so an unpriced token rendered a confident "$0.00". Stepper three-state also fixed. Regression tests: SendModal.unpricedAmount, stepperThreeState.
